source_lock: Protected educational videos/transcripts and approved Frost/Prechter book only for Elliott methodology

findings.finding: No protected source defines or authorizes a mechanical price-geometry extraction algorithm or its parameters. Pattern-family uses of the term zigzag do not establish a charting ZigZag algorithm.

findings.topic: meaningful swing or universal wave endpoint definition
findings.finding: No source-complete machine rule defines importance, a minimum move, or a universal geometric endpoint selector.

findings.topic: wave endpoints must always be new price extremes
findings.finding: No universal rule was found. PATTERN_BRAIN truncation wording expressly prevents labeling solely from failure to make a new extreme and requires an internal fifth.
Bar aggregation can conceal lower-degree subdivisions. If internals are unresolved, finer data is requested; hidden pivots must not be invented.
PATTERN_BRAIN says an extended impulse may appear as 9, 13, or more visible swings. This is pattern context, not authorization for any pivot extractor.

findings.topic: timeframe, magnitude, or duration determines degree
findings.finding: Timeframe is viewing resolution, not degree; a small five does not resolve its exact larger degree. No fixed magnitude or duration mapping is authorized.

findings.topic: fixed percentage, ATR, bar-count, or prominence threshold
findings.finding: No protected value was found; any such value is caller-supplied geometry or separately approved project operational policy, never source methodology by silence.

The active approved review records recursive subdivision, use of shorter-term data when unclear, and nonmechanical analysis with alternatives; it found no source-derived family terminal/base-case producer. It does not authorize a mechanical pivot endpoint rule.
